messages:
OpsBot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT — Hosted API queue growth detected in us-east-1. metric: request_queue_length > 1500 for 2m — paging oncall. thread_ts=3123456789
Alisha (oncall): I'm on it, joining. Seeing lots of 504s in SLO dashboard. p95 -> 2.4s, p99 -> 11.3s, error rate spike to 4.8%. :boom:
Alisha (oncall): Logs show continuous enqueueing, processing lagging. Autoscaler events show repeated failures.
Dan (support): We have an active customer ticket (cust-472) reporting mass 504s starting ~12:33 UTC, they say retries are saturating.
Priya (runtime): grabbing autoscaler logs and pool state. Suspect thundering herd from a client replaying requests + quota limits on GPU pool.
Marco (infra): I'm watching GPU pool capacity: all reserved pools at 100% and thin-provision pools maxed. Provisioner request API returning 429s from cloud provider.
Chloe (eng-ml): Could we route heavy traffic to smaller quantized variants temporarily? Might reduce per-request GPU time.
Alisha (oncall): Good idea. What's the current smart-routing config? Any safe fallbacks?
Priya (runtime): Current routing has fallback to cpu-embeddings for embeddings only. For text gen we have 'variant-lite' pinned for some customers. We can enable routing policy to prefer 'variant-lite' for non-SLA customers. Need a config flip.
Marco (infra): Trying a quick mitigation: increase queue throttle threshold to shed low-priority customers. Flipping now.
Marco (infra): *flip* applied: tenant-priority token-bucket tightened. Also sending request to provisioner to retry with exponential backoff.
OpsBot: Deploy bot: config change applied to routing/policy v1.42 — by Marco — commit sha: a1b2c3d.
Dan (support): Customer cust-472 seeing partial improvement (some requests succeeding) but still noisy. They still see increased latency on heavy calls.
Priya (runtime): Autoscaler log excerpt:
```
2026-03-15T12:34:56Z autoscaler ERROR scaleUp failed: quotaExceeded cloudProvider=acme-cloud region=us-east-1 requestedGPUs=8
2026-03-15T12:35:02Z autoscaler WARN retrying scaleUp backoff=5s attempts=3
2026-03-15T12:35:18Z provisioner ERROR createInstance rateLimitExceeded status=429
```
Priya (runtime): Provisioner hitting provider rate limits, autoscaler not handling quota rejections gracefully — it stops trying for a minute. That's why queue keeps growing.
Alisha (oncall): Oof. So we have (1) thundering herd traffic pattern from some customers, (2) provisioner blocked by provider rate limits, (3) autoscaler stalls on quota errors -> backlog grows.
Chloe (eng-ml): While infra fights provisioning, we should reduce per-request GPU time: enable KV-prefix caching for repeated prefixes, and downgrade model size for high-concurrency tenants. Can we flip a canary to route 20% of traffic to variant-quantized-ggml?
Marco (infra): Can do. I'll open a temporary route rule to divert non-SLA tenants 30% to variant-quantized.
Marco (infra): Route rule applied. Monitoring...
Alisha (oncall): Also, Priya, can you add autoscaler tolerance for quota-exceeded to continue attempts with adaptive backoff rather than giving up?
Priya (runtime): I can hotfix the autoscaler loop to treat quota errors as transient and increase retry window. Will push a small change via runtime-maint pipeline. ETA ~25m to roll out safely.
PagerDuty Bot: PagerDuty: escalation to infra senior oncall Marco acknowledged at 12:41 UTC.
Marco (infra): Starting war-room at #incident-wr. Inviting Priya and Chloe.
Dan (support): Notifying top 20 customers via status page that we are mitigating and recommending reduced retry strategies on client side. Drafting message.
Alisha (oncall): Quick safety measure: enable temporary request circuit-breaker that returns 429 for repeated retrying clients to avoid full starvation. Flip in 2m.
Marco (infra): Circuit-breaker flip applied for tenants with retry_rate > 50req/min.
Alisha (oncall): Early telemetry: p95 dropped to 980ms, p99 down to 4.6s, queue length falling from 1.6k -> 900 within 7m. Good signal.
Chloe (eng-ml): Variant route serving ~28% now. Per-token cost down and latency on those requests improved ~30%.
Dan (support): Contacts reporting partial recovery. One major customer still has increased latencies on large-context calls; they are SLA customer — routed aside from shed.
Priya (runtime): Hotfix is deployed to autoscaler: treat quotaExceeded as transient, increase max retries and jitter. Logs now show continuous retry attempts rather than immediate backoff.
Priya (runtime): autoscaler logs post-hotfix:
```
2026-03-15T12:48:10Z autoscaler INFO scaleUp attempt=5 lastError=quotaExceeded backoff=12s
2026-03-15T12:49:22Z provisioner INFO createInstance success instanceId=i-0abc123
```
Marco (infra): Provisioner slowly creating new nodes. GPU pool capacity rising.
Alisha (oncall): Keep circuit-breaker and route diversion until pools stable and p99 < 2s for 10m.
Dan (support): Updating status page: "We are mitigating an incident impacting latency and timeouts in us-east-1. Mitigations applied; some customers may see reduced throughput or temporary 429s. We'll update"
OpsBot: Incident severity updated to SEV2 — customer-impacting, mitigations in place.
Marco (infra): Queue drained to ~120 within 22m. p95=160ms, p99=820ms. Looks stable.
Chloe (eng-ml): Will run a replay test after we fully heal to validate fallback variant quality.
Alisha (oncall): Moving to post-incident: primary root cause appears to be a thundering-herd loop from a misbehaving client that retried aggressively combined with provider rate limits hitting the provisioner. Autoscaler treated quota errors as fatal and stopped scaling which amplified backlog.
Alisha (oncall): Immediate actions: 1) keep throttles until midday 2) postmortem owner: Priya 3) schedule autoscaler resilience fix to be permanent (treat quota errors as transient) — Priya
Priya (runtime): I'll own the postmortem and follow-ups: autoscaler retry policy, better alerting for 'scaleUp failed: quotaExceeded', and a test harness for provisioner rate-limit scenarios.
Marco (infra): Infra action: add fallback capacity in another region and pre-warm thin-provision pools during surge windows. Also add provider API rate-limit metrics to our SLO page.
Dan (support): Support action: update customer retry guidance + create a detection rule for clients that cause high retry patterns to contact them proactively.
Chloe (eng-ml): Eng-ML action: create an A/B evaluation for variant-quantized quality on degraded routing.
Alisha (oncall): Final status: incident resolved at 12:57 UTC. Will keep an incident channel for postmortem notes. Great coordination. :thumbsup:
PagerDuty Bot: Incident cleared on pager at 12:58 UTC.
